name: registry-config
description: Refuses package-manager config that redirects installs or weakens them: literal tokens, http or unlisted registry hosts (parsed, so lookalike and userinfo spellings fail), TLS or checksum checks off, install scripts on (npm, Yarn, pnpm, Bun, pip, uv, Poetry, conda, Go, Cargo, NuGet, Maven, Bundler, Composer, Hex, Dependabot); asks on extra indexes, replaces, no cooldown. Added only. Ship observe first. Friction, not a boundary. [Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo. Codex requires a one-time trust review per hook -- the plugin is ADVISORY until you approve its hook, and a plugin update voids that trust until re-approved.]
